title: Triangle Adept
description: Swords beat Axes. Axes beat Lances. Lances beat Swords.
body:
## Adds a 'Weapon Triangle' to Minecraft!
Entities with Swords, Axes, or Lances will deal more damage against other Entities they have advantage against, but will deal less damage with disadvantage.

- Swords are strong against 'Axe' weapons and weak against 'Lance' weapons.
  - This is only really just Swords
- 'Axes' are strong against 'Lance' weapons and weak against Swords.
  - Axes include Maces, Axes, and Pickaxes
- 'Lances' are strong against Swords and weak against 'Axe' weapons.
  - Lances include Spears, Tridents, Shovels, and Hoes.
- Bows, Crossbows, and other "unaffiliated" ranged weapons can be considered any of the above if used in the offhand while a Sword/Axe/Lance is in the mainhand.

Knowing which weapon to use against your opponent can mean the difference between winning and losing!
- Attacks with advantage deal +50% damage
- Attacks with disadvantage deal -40% damage
This applies to both mobs and players!
